propositions: A new advisory LLM criterion must judge whether a ticket declaring no repository-file impact actually describes work requiring file changes
The criterion must apply only when persisted file_impact_scope is exactly 'none'; other values must not trigger routing or LLM evaluation
The criterion's structured context must carry the persisted no_file_impact_reason through the Pass-1 request with deterministic JSON serialization
The criterion's sub-answer schema (assertion_plausible, reason_grounded, repo_file_change_named) must drive decision rules producing PASS, advisory contradiction, or insufficient coaching
The packaged routing entry must extend the shared overlay validator and registry applicability predicate to filter by required scope membership
Generated criteria-guide documentation must remain byte-identical across regenerations and exclude project-local criteria from canonical output
